title: Shrink a struct by reordering fields
summary: Alignment, padding and sizeof. Use the Layout button to see every byte.

tests.name: no padding left
expected: loan 900001: A H 250000.00 for 240 months at branch 7

hints: Press Layout. Each hatched square is a padding byte the compiler inserted so the next field starts at an address that is a multiple of its alignment.
Order the fields from the largest alignment to the smallest: the two 8-byte fields, then the 4-byte one, then the 2-byte one, then the two 1-byte chars.
